title: Peruvian-Style Casserole with Kissed Rapeseed Crust
description: A rich and flavorful casserole dish featuring a crispy kissed rapeseed crust and a hearty peruvian-inspired filling. Perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat peruvian rapeseed oil over medium heat
Add diced onion and cook until translucent
Add diced bell pepper and cook until tender
Add garlic, cumin, and chili powder, and cook for 1 minute
Stir in casserole and cook until heated through
In a separate bowl, mix together kissed rapeseed and shredded cheese
Transfer casserole mixture to a baking dish
Top with kissed rapeseed mixture and bake for 20-25 minutes
